fields.title: Knee replacement
fields.bodyHtml:
Knee replacement: innovative treatment in Israel

Knee replacement is a modern surgical treatment used for serious damage and disease of the knee joint, such as osteoarthritis. In Israel this operation is performed using advanced technologies and materials, which ensures good recovery of joint function and an improved quality of life for patients.

Investigations before knee replacement:

  1. X-ray: allows the extent of joint damage and degenerative change to be assessed.
  2. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI): used for detailed assessment of the soft tissues, cartilage and bones of the knee joint.
  3. Computed tomography (CT): may be recommended for more precise imaging of the bony structures.
  4. Laboratory tests: full blood count, biochemistry and tests for markers of inflammation, to assess general health and identify any reasons why surgery should not go ahead.

How knee replacement is carried out in Israel:

  1. Minimally invasive replacement
    The joint component is implanted through small incisions, which reduces injury and speeds recovery.
  2. Total replacement
    Complete surgical removal of the damaged tissue and its replacement with a prosthesis that reproduces the natural movement of the knee.
  3. Partial replacement
    Suitable where only part of the cartilage is damaged.
  4. Bilateral replacement
    Replacement of both sides at once, preferable for patients in whom both knees are affected.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • Advanced technology: the use of modern prostheses and minimally invasive surgical techniques.
  • Highly qualified specialists: experienced surgeons and rehabilitation specialists who focus on joint disease and injury.
  • An individual approach: a personalised programme of treatment and rehabilitation for every patient.
  • A comprehensive approach to recovery: an extensive rehabilitation programme aimed at restoring knee function quickly and improving quality of life.

Knee replacement in Israel gives patients access to the best international practice, with a high rate of successful outcomes and a minimal risk of complications.

fields.title: Endoscopic discectomy
fields.bodyHtml:
Endoscopic discectomy is a minimally invasive surgical procedure designed to relieve back pain caused by a herniated disc. It is well suited to patients whose pain has not been eased by conservative treatment such as medication or physiotherapy.

Key features of the procedure:

  1. Minimal injury: the procedure is carried out through a small incision using specialised endoscopic equipment, which minimises pain after surgery and speeds recovery.
  2. Precisely targeted intervention: the endoscope allows the surgeon to remove only the affected part of the disc accurately and carefully, leaving healthy tissue and the structures of the spine intact.
  3. No metal implants: the procedure uses no metal implants or constructions, which spares patients the complications that can go with them.
  4. Rapid recovery: the hospital stay after the procedure is just one day, and full recovery usually takes up to a week — considerably faster than with traditional surgery.
  5. High effectiveness: endoscopic discectomy produces excellent results in relieving pain and improving mobility and quality of life.

The procedure is recommended for patients diagnosed with a herniated disc who have severe pain and other symptoms that have not responded to standard treatment.

fields.title: Facelift: facial rejuvenation
fields.bodyHtml:
What is a facelift?

A facelift is a surgical procedure to tighten the skin and reshape the contours of the face. It is one of the most popular operations in plastic surgery, particularly among patients over 40. In Israel the procedure is carried out by leading plastic surgeons using the most modern and innovative techniques, which guarantees safety and a high-quality result.

Types of facelift

  1. Full facelift: a comprehensive operation covering the forehead, cheeks, chin and neck.
  2. Mini facelift: a minimally invasive procedure aimed at correcting particular areas of the face.
  3. SMAS lift: lifting of the superficial musculoaponeurotic system to improve the contours of the face and neck.
  4. Contouring with fillers: the use of fillers to restore volume and smooth wrinkles.
  5. Biorevitalisation: injectable treatments for deep hydration and rejuvenation of the skin.
  6. Thread lift: lifting of the skin with special threads that stimulate the collagen framework.

Indications

A facelift is recommended in the following cases:

  • Wrinkles and folds in the skin of the face.
  • Sagging and loss of skin tone.
  • Fat deposits around the chin and neck.
  • Drooping of the tissues (ptosis).
  • Pronounced nasolabial folds.
  • Drooping of the upper eyelids and brows.
  • Changes in the contours of the face with age.

How the facelift procedure is carried out

The procedure is performed under local anaesthetic and takes about an hour and a half to two hours. The surgeon makes small incisions around the ears, through which excess fat and skin are removed. New facial contours are then formed and the muscles tightened. At the end of the operation a bandage is applied to the face and drainage tubes are fitted to allow fluid to escape.

Recovery after a facelift

After the procedure the patient remains under the care of specialists at the clinic. The dressings and drainage tubes are removed after two days, and if there are no complications the patient goes home. Full recovery takes about two weeks, during which physical activity and the use of cosmetics should be avoided. The results of the operation appear over several weeks and last for many years.

Why choose Israel for a facelift?

Israeli clinics and specialists are known for their high professionalism and their use of advanced techniques. The advantages of having a facelift in Israel include:

  • Highly qualified and experienced surgeons.
  • The use of the most modern technologies and innovative methods.
  • An individual approach to every patient.
  • Minimal risk and a high level of safety.
  • Comfortable conditions for recovery and follow-up.

A facelift in Israel is a chance to restore youth and beauty to your face with the assurance of good results and safety.

fields.title: Gastritis
fields.bodyHtml:
Gastritis: advanced treatment in Israel

Gastritis is inflammation of the lining of the stomach, which can be caused by various factors including infection, stress, alcohol, certain medicines and autoimmune processes. Modern approaches to diagnosis and treatment are available in Israel, aimed at removing the causes of gastritis and easing its symptoms.

Diagnosis of gastritis:

  1. Endoscopy: allows the doctor to examine the lining of the stomach and take tissue samples for biopsy, which is necessary to determine the type of inflammation and the presence of infections such as Helicobacter pylori.
  2. Tests for Helicobacter pylori:
    • Urea breath test: a non-invasive method of detecting H. pylori.
    • Blood, stool or biopsy tests: looking for antibodies or genetic markers of the bacterium.
  3. Barium X-ray of the stomach: may be used to assess structural changes in the stomach and how it functions.

Methods of treating gastritis:

  1. Drug treatment:
    • Antacids and proton pump inhibitors: to reduce the acidity of the stomach contents and protect the lining.
    • Antibiotics: where H. pylori infection is found, to eradicate it.
    • Medicines that protect the lining: such as sucralfate, which help inflamed areas to heal.
  2. Diet and lifestyle changes:
    • Dietary advice: avoiding spicy and fatty food and alcohol. Eating small portions is recommended.
    • Giving up smoking and reducing stress: since these factors can make the symptoms of gastritis worse.
  3. Supportive treatment:
    • Probiotics: may be recommended to maintain a healthy gut flora and improve digestion.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • A multidisciplinary approach: gastroenterologists, dietitians and psychologists work together to provide comprehensive care.
  • Use of advanced technology: access to the newest methods of diagnosis and treatment, which improves the effectiveness of therapy.
  • Individual treatment: treatment plans drawn up with each patient's particular circumstances and needs in mind.

Treatment of gastritis in Israel is aimed at removing the causes of the condition and easing its symptoms, which helps patients restore and maintain their health and quality of life.
